command: set -e && if [ -x /shared/pgbackrest ]; then echo "pgbackrest already installed"; exit 0; fi && echo "Installing pgbackrest into /shared..." && export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends pgbackrest && cp "$(command -v pgbackrest)" /shared/pgbackrest && chmod 0755 /shared/pgbackrest && echo "done"
initContainers.name: pgbackrest-install
